store.tagline: Confetti for your thank-you pages, after an order, sign-up or booking.
store.longDescription:
Celebrate adds a burst of confetti to the happy moments on your site: the thank-you page after an order, a sign-up or a booking, a welcome page, a launch. List the pages that should open with confetti, and any link that points to #celebrate gives a burst when it is clicked.

Pick confetti, hearts or stars, in party colours, gold, pastel or your own colour, and choose a cheerful burst or a proper party. It lasts three seconds, is drawn on a layer that never gets in the way of a click, and then disappears.

Visitors who ask their device for less motion see no animation at all. It is a little over a kilobyte of script, added only to the pages that use it.

The plugin asks for one permission, storage, to keep its settings; refused, it celebrates on pages called thanks, thank-you and bedankt.
